plugins.name: volcengine-core
plugins.description: Core Volcengine discovery, documentation search, CLI operations, troubleshooting, and voluntary community feedback skills.
plugins.short_description: Discover, operate, troubleshoot, and improve Volcengine skills
default_prompts: Find the Volcengine skill for my task.
Look up how to use this Volcengine product.
Diagnose this Volcengine error.
Draft feedback about my experience using Volcengine skills.

skills.name: volcengine-billing-and-cost-management
skills.summary: Analyze cloud cost changes and attribute anomalies to products, charge items, usage, price, and amount components.
skills.summary_zh: 分析云费用波动，定位产品、计费项及用量、单价和金额构成的归因。

skills.name: volcengine-cli
skills.summary: Manage Volcengine resources with ve; route TOS and Ark tasks to product skills using ve tosutil and ve arkcli.
skills.summary_zh: 使用 ve 管理火山引擎资源；引导获取 TOS、Ark 技能，并通过 ve tosutil、ve arkcli 执行。

skills.name: volcengine-troubleshooting
skills.summary: Diagnose Volcengine errors, resource health, quotas, metrics, and OpenAPI failures.
skills.summary_zh: 诊断火山引擎错误、资源状态、配额、指标与 OpenAPI 故障。

skills.name: volcengine-knowledge-search
skills.summary: Search and fetch official Volcengine documentation with ve docs search/fetch, without login.
skills.summary_zh: 使用 ve docs search/fetch 检索并获取火山引擎官方文档全文，无需登录。

skills.name: volcengine-find-skills
skills.summary: List all Volcengine skills so an agent can select and install missing capabilities.
skills.summary_zh: 列出全部火山引擎技能，供 Agent 选择并安装当前缺失的能力。

skills.name: volcengine-feedback
skills.summary: Draft and submit voluntary, redacted GitHub feedback on usage issues, capability needs, practical scenarios, and successful workflows without blocking the main task.
skills.summary_zh: 整理并提交脱敏的 GitHub 使用反馈，涵盖问题、能力需求、实际场景和成功实践，始终不阻塞主任务。

plugins.name: volcengine-storage
plugins.description: Operate Volcengine storage products and data with product-specific tools.
plugins.short_description: Manage Volcengine object storage and log service
default_prompts: Manage these TOS buckets and objects with tosutil.
Search and analyze logs in this TLS topic with volclog.
Set up LogCollector to collect these logs into TLS.

skills.name: volcengine-tosutil
skills.summary: Manage TOS buckets and objects with the tosutil command-line tool.
skills.summary_zh: 使用 tosutil 命令行工具管理 TOS 桶和对象。

skills.name: volcengine-tls
skills.summary: Operate Volcengine TLS log service with volclog: contract-first discover/describe/exec, log search, analysis, ingest, export, and error recovery.
skills.summary_zh: 使用 volclog 操作火山引擎日志服务 TLS：按契约发现/描述/执行，覆盖日志检索、分析、导入、导出与错误恢复。

skills.name: volcengine-tls-logcollector
skills.summary: Design, validate, deploy, and troubleshoot TLS LogCollector collection on Linux hosts or Kubernetes through volclog.
skills.summary_zh: 通过 volclog 设计、校验、部署并排查 Linux 主机或 Kubernetes 上的 TLS LogCollector 日志采集。

plugins.name: volcengine-database
plugins.description: Build and operate database-backed applications on Volcengine managed database platforms.
plugins.short_description: Operate Volcengine AI-native BaaS and PostgreSQL
default_prompts: Create and configure a Volcengine Supabase workspace.

skills.name: volcengine-db-supabase
skills.summary: Manage Volcengine AI-native BaaS Supabase workspaces, SQL, Auth, Realtime, and Edge Functions.
skills.summary_zh: 管理火山引擎 AI 原生 BaaS Supabase 工作区、SQL、Auth、Realtime 与 Edge Functions。

plugins.name: volcengine-containers-middleware
plugins.description: Deploy and manage Volcengine serverless, container, and middleware application runtimes.
plugins.short_description: Deploy and manage veFaaS serverless applications
default_prompts: Deploy this project as a veFaaS application.

skills.name: volcengine-vefaas
skills.summary: Deploy veFaaS applications and MCP servers, and manage functions, sandboxes, and OpenAPI calls through the vefaas CLI.
skills.summary_zh: 通过 vefaas CLI 部署 veFaaS 应用和 MCP 服务，管理函数、沙箱并调用 OpenAPI。

plugins.name: volcengine-security
plugins.description: Assess security and compliance posture, query audit logs, and manage CloudTrail for Volcengine accounts and resources.
plugins.short_description: Assess compliance and manage CloudTrail audit data
default_prompts: Review this Volcengine account's compliance posture.
Investigate these Volcengine audit events and safely manage the relevant CloudTrail.

skills.name: volcengine-compliance
skills.summary: Recommend compliance baselines, report posture, and author custom Rego compliance rules.
skills.summary_zh: 推荐合规基线、汇总合规态势并编写自定义 Rego 合规规则。

skills.name: volcengine-cloud-trail
skills.summary: Query CloudTrail audit logs and manage trails and backfill delivery tasks.
skills.summary_zh: 查询操作审计日志，并管理跟踪和历史补投任务。

plugins.name: volcengine-identity-access-control
plugins.description: Design and establish Volcengine landing zones, organizations, identity, account factories, and governance baselines.
plugins.short_description: Set up landing zones, identity, and governance
default_prompts: Design a Volcengine landing zone for this organization.

skills.name: volcengine-landing-zone
skills.summary: Consult, set up, and manage Volcengine landing zones and account baselines, and deploy solutions or blueprints.
skills.summary_zh: 咨询、搭建和管理火山引擎 Landing Zone 与账号基线，并支持部署方案或蓝图。

plugins.name: volcengine-service-support
plugins.description: Route product transactions (purchase, price enquiry, unsubscribe), prepare and deploy applications, manage infrastructure as code, explore OpenAPI specifications, and generate runnable SDK examples.
plugins.short_description: Route transactions, prepare deployments, and support API integrations
default_prompts: Open a Volcengine Ark endpoint / veFaaS app / TLS project / TOS bucket.
How much does this Volcengine product cost for my usage?
Unsubscribe a prepaid Volcengine instance.
Assess this repository for Volcengine deployment.
Deploy this application to Volcengine.
Create Terraform for this Volcengine architecture.
Find the request schema for this Volcengine API.
Generate a runnable SDK example for this API.

skills.name: volcengine-sale
skills.summary: Orchestrate Volcengine product transactions: purchase, price enquiry, and unsubscribe.
skills.summary_zh: 编排火山商品交易意图：识别开通购买、询价预估与退订三类动作并分流执行。

skills.name: volcengine-prepare
skills.summary: Analyze a repository and recommend ECS, VKE, or veFaaS deployment shapes.
skills.summary_zh: 分析代码仓库并推荐 ECS、VKE 或 veFaaS 部署形态。

skills.name: volcengine-deploy
skills.summary: Deploy a local directory or Git repository to Volcengine.
skills.summary_zh: 将本地目录或 Git 仓库部署到火山引擎。

skills.name: volcengine-iac
skills.summary: Manage Volcengine infrastructure with Terraform and infrastructure as code.
skills.summary_zh: 使用 Terraform 和基础设施即代码管理火山引擎资源。

skills.name: volcengine-api
skills.summary: Query Volcengine API specifications, parameters, errors, and response structures.
skills.summary_zh: 查询火山引擎 API 规格、参数、错误码和返回结构。

skills.name: volcengine-sdk-generator
skills.summary: Generate accurate, runnable Volcengine SDK examples in supported languages.
skills.summary_zh: 生成准确、可运行的多语言火山引擎 SDK 示例。
